title: standard_registry_has_expected_tool_count requires manual update per tool addition
description: Adding RunCommandTool to ToolRegistry::standard() required updating the hardcoded count assertion in tool_executor_tests.rs from 24 to 25, causing no-test-regression to fail in run 9ef065cf-469d-4284-ab94-bbee84e3c208. Every future tool addition to standard() will trigger this same failure unless the test is redesigned. Recurred in run c6af8022-8df4-4edf-8bb0-97b1a8dda8b8 when ArchiveSignalTool was added, requiring update from 25 to 26.
proposed_resolution: Replace the hardcoded count in standard_registry_has_expected_tool_count with per-name assertions (e.g. assert!(defs.iter().any(|d| d.name == "run_command"))). This makes the test resilient to additions and only fails when tools are unexpectedly removed.
